Welcome to Parley

Add a WhatsApp account. Accounts keep running in the background and notify you even with every window closed.

How background works

Use Send to background to hide the window: WhatsApp stays loaded and opens again instantly. Closing the window also keeps the account running, but it reloads in the background. Click a notification to reopen the window.
